description: Search England's listed buildings by name and get list entry number, grade (I, II*, II), listing date, grid reference and the link to the official Historic England record. Useful for homebuyers, conveyancers, builders and planners asking 'is this building listed'. Source: Historic England National Heritage List for England. Matches the list entry name only (often the address or building name as written when listed), not street addresses generally; England only, and it does not cover conservation areas or local lists. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, part of the list entry name, e.g. 'TOWER BRIDGE' (case-insensitive, 2-100 chars)

name: listed_building_search
